Customer Terms of Use

These Terms explain how you register on the Mezzofy B2C Marketplace, get and own Passes, redeem them at the Merchant’s locations, and transfer them where allowed. In short: the Merchant provides the product or service behind each Pass and handles disputes about it; Mezzofy runs the Marketplace and protects you if a Merchant stops operating; and Passes are not refundable.

Before you begin

These are the customer Terms of Use for the Mezzofy B2C Marketplace at marketplace.mezzofy.com. Read them together with each Pass’s own Pass Terms and the Mezzofy Privacy Policy. The English version prevails. You accept them when you create an account or download, buy, receive, transfer or redeem any Pass.

§1

Parties and acceptance

1.1 These Terms are between you and Mezzofy Holding Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong with company number 394841, and its affiliates that operate the Marketplace in your country (“Mezzofy”, “we”, “us”).

1.2 You accept these Terms when you create an account, tick the acceptance box, or download, buy, receive, transfer or redeem any Pass. If you do not agree, please do not use the Marketplace.

1.3 These Terms include the Mezzofy Privacy Policy and the Pass Terms of each Pass you hold. If a Pass’s Pass Terms conflict with these Terms on how that Pass is redeemed or used, the Pass Terms apply to that Pass. On every other matter, these Terms apply.

§2

Eligibility

2.1 You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you live, to create an account and buy Passes. If you are younger, you may use the Marketplace only with the consent and supervision of a parent or guardian, who accepts these Terms on your behalf.

2.2 Some Passes, such as those for alcohol, are restricted by age or eligibility. The Merchant may check your identity and age at redemption and refuse redemption if you are not eligible.

2.3 The Marketplace is for personal, non-commercial use. Businesses that want to buy Passes in bulk must use Mezzofy’s B2B Portal.

§3

Definitions

In these Terms:

  • “Marketplace” means the Mezzofy B2C Marketplace at marketplace.mezzofy.com, its apps, and any NFC tag or QR code that lets you collect Passes.
  • “Merchant” means the business that issues a Pass and provides the product or service it represents.
  • “Pass” means a digital coupon, voucher, gift card, e-ticket, membership pass, stamp card or other entitlement issued by a Merchant through the Marketplace, identified by a unique Token.
  • “Pass Terms” means the conditions shown on a Pass, including what you receive, participating locations, validity and expiry dates, exclusions, and whether the Pass can be transferred.
  • “Token” means the unique digital code Mezzofy generates for each Pass to check that it is genuine and unused.
  • “Purchase Price” means the amount you actually paid for a Pass, after any discount and including taxes.
  • “Active Pass” means a Pass that is valid, has not expired, has not been redeemed or voided, and shows as active in your account.
§4

Your account

4.1 You need an account to download, buy, hold, transfer or redeem Passes. You must give accurate details, including a valid email address or mobile number, and keep them up to date.

4.2 You may hold one personal account. Your account and Passes are linked to you and must not be sold, rented or shared, except by transferring individual Passes under clause 7.

4.3 Keep your password and any one-time codes private. You are responsible for activity in your account, including redemptions made with your Passes. Tell us at support@mezzofy.com as soon as possible if you think someone else has accessed your account, and we will help secure it and your Active Passes.

4.4 You can close your account at any time from your account settings or by contacting support. Any Active Passes still in your account when you close it will be lost unless you redeem or transfer them first.

§5

Getting and owning Passes

5.1 You can get Passes on the Marketplace in two ways: by downloading Passes offered free of charge, or by buying Passes at the price shown. You may also receive a Pass by tapping an NFC tag, scanning a QR code, or through a transfer from another customer.

5.2 Before you download or buy a Pass, read its Pass Terms carefully. They tell you what the Pass gives you, where and when you can use it, when it expires, and whether it can be transferred.

5.3 Prices are shown in the currency displayed at checkout and include taxes where the law requires. Passes bought in Indonesia are priced and paid in Indonesian Rupiah. Payments are processed by Mezzofy’s licensed payment providers (currently including Stripe). Mezzofy collects payment on behalf of the Merchant. Your payment card or wallet provider may charge its own fees, such as currency conversion charges.

5.4 A Pass is yours once it appears in your account: after your payment is confirmed for a paid Pass, or once you have claimed a free Pass. You then hold the right to redeem the Pass with the Merchant under its Pass Terms, or to transfer it where clause 7 allows.

5.5 Owning a Pass gives you a right to the product or service it describes. A Pass is not cash, a bank deposit or an investment, cannot be exchanged for cash, and does not earn interest. You may not sell Passes for profit or use them for any commercial purpose.

5.6 Passes may be limited in number or offered for a limited time. Mezzofy may limit how many of a Pass you can download or buy, and may cancel an order before the Pass is issued if a pricing error or technical error has occurred. If we cancel a paid order for this reason, we will return your payment in full.

5.7 You are responsible for checking your Passes and their expiry dates in your account. Mezzofy may send reminders, but expired Passes cannot be used or reinstated.

§6

Redeeming Passes

6.1 You can redeem an Active Pass at the locations named in its Pass Terms, within its validity period and subject to any booking requirements, blackout dates or other conditions it states.

6.2 To redeem, show the Pass in your account (for example its QR code or NFC tap) to the Merchant, who will validate it through Mezzofy’s system. A Pass can be redeemed only once unless its Pass Terms say otherwise. Screenshots, printed copies and Passes already redeemed, expired or voided will not be accepted.

6.3 The Merchant must honour every Active Pass in line with its Pass Terms. The Merchant must not charge you anything extra that the Pass Terms do not mention.

6.4 Once a Pass is redeemed it is marked as used and cannot be used again, even if you did not use the full benefit, unless the Pass Terms allow partial use.

6.5 Mezzofy’s validation record is the reference for whether a Pass is active, redeemed, expired or voided. If you believe this record is wrong, contact support@mezzofy.com and we will investigate.

6.6 Mezzofy may void a Pass if we reasonably believe it was obtained or used through fraud, error or a breach of these Terms. Where the Pass was not obtained through your fault, we will replace it or treat it under clause 8.

§7

Transferring Passes

7.1 You may transfer an Active Pass to another customer only if its Pass Terms show it as transferable. Whether a Pass can be transferred, how many times, and to whom, is decided by the Merchant and may differ from Pass to Pass.

7.2 Transfers must be made through the Marketplace’s transfer function. The person receiving the Pass must have, or create, a Marketplace account and accept these Terms.

7.3 Once a transfer is completed, the Pass and all rights to it belong to the recipient and are removed from your account. Transfers are final and cannot be reversed, so check the recipient’s details before you confirm.

7.4 A transferred Pass keeps its original Pass Terms and expiry date. Transferring a Pass does not extend its validity.

7.5 Transfers are for gifting and personal sharing. You must not sell or advertise Passes for sale, or transfer them in exchange for payment, unless Mezzofy introduces an official resale feature that allows it.

7.6 Mezzofy may block or reverse a transfer that it reasonably believes involves fraud, a stolen account, a breach of the Pass Terms or commercial resale.

§8

Disputes, Merchant closure protection and refunds

Who to contact

Your issueWho to contact
Quality, quantity or description of the product or service; service at the location; booking or availability; the Merchant refusing a valid PassThe Merchant, as the provider of the product or service
The Pass not showing in your account, a validation error, a transfer problem, or a payment problemMezzofy at support@mezzofy.com
The Merchant has closed, stopped operating or gone out of businessMezzofy at support@mezzofy.com, under clause 8.4

8.1 Merchant disputes. The Merchant is solely responsible for the product or service behind each Pass. If you have a complaint about it, contact the Merchant first using the details on the Pass. Mezzofy is not the provider of the product or service and is not responsible for its quality, safety or performance.

8.2 If the Merchant does not respond within 14 days, or refuses to honour an Active Pass at a named location, you may tell Mezzofy. We will contact the Merchant and try to help resolve the issue, but we cannot guarantee an outcome for disputes about the product or service itself.

8.3 Platform issues. Mezzofy is responsible for the Marketplace itself, including issuing, storing, validating and transferring Passes. If a Pass cannot be used because of a Marketplace error, we will fix the error or replace the Pass.

8.4 Merchant closure protection. If a Merchant permanently closes, stops operating or goes out of business so that you can no longer redeem an Active Pass at any of its locations, Mezzofy will protect you as follows:

  • (a) You may ask Mezzofy to exchange the affected Active Pass for one or more Passes from other Merchants on the Marketplace of equivalent value.
  • (b) For a paid Pass, equivalent value means the Purchase Price you paid for it. For a Pass you received by transfer, it means the Purchase Price originally paid for that Pass.
  • (c) For a Pass you received free of charge, Mezzofy may offer a replacement free Pass of similar type where one is available.
  • (d) You must make your request through support@mezzofy.com or your account within 90 days after Mezzofy notifies you of the closure, or within 90 days after the closure if we could not notify you. You may make the request even if the Pass’s original expiry date has passed during that time.
  • (e) The exchange applies only to Passes that were Active Passes on the date the Merchant stopped operating, and not to Passes that had already expired, been redeemed or been voided.
  • (f) Replacement Passes come with their own Pass Terms and expiry dates. Mezzofy will offer a reasonable choice of available Passes. If none of equal value is available, we may combine Passes, or issue Marketplace credit of equivalent value for use on other Passes.

8.5 No refunds. All Passes are non-refundable. Once a Pass is issued to your account, you cannot cancel it or exchange it for cash. The only remedies are the redemption of the Pass with the Merchant, the help described in clauses 8.2 and 8.3, and the exchange under clause 8.4.

8.6 Nothing in these Terms removes any right you have under consumer protection law in your country that cannot be excluded by contract. If such a law entitles you to a refund, Mezzofy will provide it as required.

8.7 If your card issuer reverses a payment (a chargeback) for a Pass you have received, Mezzofy may void that Pass and suspend your account while the chargeback is reviewed. Please contact us first so we can help.

§9

Your conduct

You must not:

  • (a) copy, alter, forge or duplicate a Pass, Token or QR code, or try to redeem a Pass more than once;
  • (b) create multiple or fake accounts, or use bots or scripts, to collect more Passes than allowed;
  • (c) sell, auction or advertise Passes for sale, or use them for any commercial purpose;
  • (d) use stolen payment details or another person’s account;
  • (e) tamper with, copy or move NFC tags or QR codes placed by Mezzofy or its partners;
  • (f) interfere with, scrape or attempt to gain unauthorised access to the Marketplace; or
  • (g) abuse, threaten or harass Merchant staff or Mezzofy staff.

If you breach this clause, Mezzofy may void the affected Passes, suspend or close your account, and report the matter to the authorities. Passes voided for your breach are not covered by clause 8.

§10

Privacy

10.1 Mezzofy collects and uses your personal data as described in the Mezzofy Privacy Policy, in line with applicable data protection laws, such as Hong Kong’s PDPO, Singapore’s PDPA, Malaysia’s PDPA and Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27 of 2022).

10.2 When you redeem or receive a Pass, Mezzofy shares with the Merchant only the information needed to validate the Pass and provide the product or service, such as your name and Pass details. Merchants may not use this information for their own marketing unless you give them your consent directly.

10.3 When you transfer a Pass, the recipient will see your display name as the sender, and you will see the recipient’s details you entered.

10.4 You can choose whether to receive marketing messages from Mezzofy and change your choice at any time in your account settings.

§11

Intellectual property

Mezzofy owns the Marketplace, its software, design and trademarks. Merchants own their names, logos and Pass content. You may use the Marketplace only for your personal use under these Terms, and you may not copy, modify or reuse its content for any other purpose.
§12

Our responsibility to you

12.1 Mezzofy will provide the Marketplace with reasonable care and skill. We try to keep it available at all times, but it may sometimes be interrupted for maintenance or reasons beyond our control.

12.2 Mezzofy is not responsible for the product or service provided by a Merchant, or for any loss or injury it causes, except where the law makes us responsible. Claims about the product or service should be made against the Merchant.

12.3 To the extent permitted by law, Mezzofy is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for loss of profit or opportunity. Mezzofy’s total liability to you in connection with any Pass is limited to the Purchase Price of that Pass, or to the remedies in clause 8 where they apply.

12.4 Nothing in these Terms limits liability for fraud, for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any other liability that cannot be limited by law.

§13

Suspension and termination

13.1 Mezzofy may suspend or close your account if you breach these Terms, if we reasonably suspect fraud or misuse, or if the law requires it. Where possible, we will tell you why.

13.2 If Mezzofy closes your account for reasons other than your breach, we will give you reasonable notice so that you can redeem or transfer your Active Passes.

13.3 If Mezzofy stops operating the Marketplace in your country, we will give you at least 30 days’ notice and tell you how your Active Passes can still be redeemed.

§14

Changes to these Terms

Mezzofy may update these Terms by giving notice on the Marketplace or by email. Material changes take effect no earlier than 30 days after notice, unless a change is required by law or for security reasons. Changes do not reduce the benefit of Passes you already hold. If you continue to use the Marketplace after a change takes effect, you accept the updated Terms.
§15

Governing law and disputes with Mezzofy

15.1 These Terms are governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

15.2 If you have a complaint about Mezzofy, please contact support@mezzofy.com first, and we will try to resolve it within 30 days.

15.3 If we cannot resolve it, either party may bring the dispute before the courts of Hong Kong. You may also bring a claim in the courts of the country where you live, and you keep any protection given to you by the mandatory consumer laws of that country.

§16

General

16.1 Mezzofy may transfer its rights and obligations under these Terms to an affiliate or a successor business. If we do, your rights under these Terms will not be reduced.

16.2 If any part of these Terms is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect.

16.3 These Terms are written in English. Translations are provided for convenience; if they conflict, the English version prevails unless local law requires otherwise. For customers in Indonesia, these Terms are also provided in Bahasa Indonesia, as required by Indonesian law.

§17

Contact

We are here to help:

  • Customer support and Merchant closure requests — support@mezzofy.com
  • Legal notices — legal@mezzofy.com
  • Marketplace — marketplace.mezzofy.com
